title: Machine Learning Engineer Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step guide to go from zero to a job‑ready ML engineer. It builds solid foundations, core ML skills, a showcase portfolio, and job‑ready readiness.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Build the programming and math base needed for ML.

milestones.title: Version control basics
milestones.outcome: Track code changes and collaborate using Git.

tasks.title: Read Git Handbook on Git‑SCM.com
tasks.description: Learn core concepts like commit, branch, and merge.

tasks.title: Create a branch and merge a feature
tasks.description: Practice branching workflow in your GitHub repo.

tasks.title: Resolve a merge conflict scenario
tasks.description: Simulate a conflict and use tools to resolve it.

tasks.title: Document workflow in README.md
tasks.description: Write clear instructions for future collaborators.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Learn essential ML libraries and evaluation methods.

milestones.title: Model evaluation techniques
milestones.outcome: Select appropriate metrics and validate models robustly.

tasks.title: Read Model Evaluation chapter on Coursera ML course
tasks.description: Focus on precision, recall, ROC, and confusion matrix.

tasks.title: Compute classification metrics on a Kaggle dataset
tasks.description: Use scikit‑learn functions to generate reports.

tasks.title: Create a visual ROC curve plot with Matplotlib
Write a short blog post summarizing findings
tasks.description: Explain why chosen metrics matter for the problem.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Build portfolio projects that showcase end‑to‑end ML pipelines.

milestones.title: Model monitoring dashboard
milestones.outcome: Track model performance over time in a visual UI.

tasks.title: Create synthetic data stream script in Python
tasks.description: Generate predictions and true labels continuously.

tasks.title: Set up Prometheus metrics exporter for model latency
tasks.description: Expose latency as a metric endpoint.

tasks.title: Build a Grafana dashboard visualizing metrics
tasks.description: Plot latency, error rate, and data drift indicators.

tasks.title: Simulate a drift scenario and observe dashboard alerts
tasks.description: Change input distribution and note metric changes.

tasks.title: Write a short reflection on monitoring importance
tasks.description: Summarize lessons learned for future projects.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Advance your expertise, master MLOps, and prepare for job search.

milestones.title: Job and client readiness
milestones.outcome: Craft compelling applications and interview confidently.

tasks.title: Update LinkedIn profile with ML projects
tasks.description: Add project titles, descriptions, and links.

tasks.title: Prepare a 5‑minute elevator pitch for each portfolio project
tasks.description: Focus on problem, solution, impact, and metrics.

tasks.title: Mock technical interview on LeetCode Medium problems
Attend a virtual ML meetup and network
Reflect on feedback and adjust résumé
